fields.why: Tables 1–3 give weighted percentages, by state, for four race/ethnicity groups and four age groups.
Sex is a pair, and the presence of a child in the home is not an SPD.

The only test implied ('significantly higher') is men vs women, a pair. No testing method or overlap rule is stated, so the race and age values with their CIs are only set side by side, and the flag is a false alarm.
